newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian lorry crash kills 30 in river.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian lorry crash kills 30 in river.

text.p: At least 30 people, mostly women returning from a market, died when their lorry plunged down a steep bank and into a river in western Nigeria, newspapers reported on Wednesday.
The Daily Times said the accident happened at the weekend when the brakes failed on the vehicle which was driving on the road between the towns of Igbesi and Ilorin.
